excerpt: Let your AI agents call and text your actual iPhone — Claude Code plugin + agent skill - radres/call-me
content_html:
Call Me — agent integrations

Your AI agents can ring your actual iPhone, speak a question, and get your spoken answer back as text — or just text you. This repo has the agent-side integrations for the Call Me iOS app (formerly AI Phone).

1. Get the app

Call Me on the App Store — free. Open it, tap Agree & Continue, and it shows your personal Call Me number: 10 digits, and all an agent needs to reach you.

Already in a terminal with the CLI? callme qr prints a scannable QR code for that link, and callme setup prints these steps for you.

2. Connect Claude Code (recommended)

Send these as two separate messages (slash commands only run one per message):

/plugin marketplace add radres/call-me

/plugin install call-me@call-me

Then just tell Claude: "set up Call Me". It asks for the number from the app, remembers it, and sends you a confirmation text. From then on Claude can text you and ring your phone, and your replies from the app flow straight back into the live session.

You can also paste the number into the plugin's config field when prompted — same result. Either way it lands in ~/.aiphone/config.json, so every Claude session on the machine reaches your phone, and re-pairing to a new phone takes effect immediately without restarting anything.

3. Any other agent (Codex, scripts, cron jobs, …)

Use the standalone skill in skill/. It's a single bash+curl CLI:

git clone https://github.com/radres/call-me
cp call-me/skill/callme ~/bin/   # or anywhere on PATH

callme pair 5551234567                  # once — the number from the app
callme call "Deploy staging or prod first?"   # blocks until you answer by voice
callme text "Build green, PR merged."         # push notification

Agents that support skills can point at skill/SKILL.md directly — it teaches the full flow (setup, pair, call, text, listen, title).

Teach your agent

Drop this in your CLAUDE.md / agent instructions:

I'm reachable on my phone through Call Me.
Claude Code: install the call-me plugin from github.com/radres/call-me,
then run its setup tool if we aren't paired yet.
Other agents: use the callme CLI (skill/ dir) — `callme setup` explains
pairing, then `callme call "question"` rings me and returns what I say.

Notice there's no number in there: the number is a credential, so it lives in ~/.aiphone/config.json (mode 0600) instead of your notes. callme number reads it back, callme pair <number> changes it.

How it works

  • callme call POSTs your question to the Call Me service; your iPhone rings through CallKit like a real call, TTS speaks the question, your spoken reply is transcribed and returned to the agent. The call blocks until you answer — that's the point.
  • callme text sends a push-notification message; replies from the phone are delivered back into channel-enabled agent sessions (Claude Code plugin) or fetched with callme listen / callme events.
  • Each agent session registers its own number and thread, so your phone shows separate, titled conversations per task.

content_html_zh:
呼叫我 — 代理集成

您的人工智能代理可以拨打您的实际 iPhone，说出问题，然后将您的口头回答以文本形式返回，或者只是发短信给您。 此存储库具有 Call Me iOS 应用程序（以前称为 AI Phone）的代理端集成。

1. 获取应用程序

在 App Store 上呼叫我 — 免费。 打开它，点击“同意并继续”，它会显示您的个人“呼叫我”号码：10 位数字，以及客服人员联系您所需的所有信息。

已经在使用 CLI 的终端中了吗？ callme qr 会打印该链接的可扫描二维码，callme setup 会为您打印这些步骤。

2. 连接克劳德代码（推荐）

将它们作为两条单独的消息发送（斜杠命令每条消息仅运行一条）：

/plugin marketplace add radres/call-me

/plugin install call-me@call-me

然后告诉克劳德：“设置呼叫我”。 它会要求应用程序提供号码，记住它，然后向您发送确认文本。 从那时起，克劳德可以给您发短信并拨打您的电话，您从应用程序中的回复会直接返回实时会话。

您还可以在出现提示时将数字粘贴到插件的配置字段中 - 相同的结果。 无论哪种方式，它都会落在 ~/.aiphone/config.json 中，因此计算机上的每个 Claude 会话都会到达您的手机，并且与新手机的重新配对会立即生效，而无需重新启动任何内容。

3. 任何其他代理（Codex、脚本、cron 作业……）

使用技能/中的独立技能。 这是一个 bash+curl CLI：

git clone https://github.com/radres/call-me
cp call-me/skill/callme ~/bin/   # or anywhere on PATH

callme pair 5551234567                  # once — the number from the app
callme call "Deploy staging or prod first?"   # blocks until you answer by voice
callme text "Build green, PR merged."         # push notification

支持技能的代理可以直接指向 Skill/SKILL.md — 它教授完整的流程（设置、配对、呼叫、文本、收听、标题）。

教你的代理人

将其放入您的 CLAUDE.md/代理说明中：

I'm reachable on my phone through Call Me.
Claude Code: install the call-me plugin from github.com/radres/call-me,
then run its setup tool if we aren't paired yet.
Other agents: use the callme CLI (skill/ dir) — `callme setup` explains
pairing, then `callme call "question"` rings me and returns what I say.

请注意，其中没有数字：该数字是凭证，因此它位于 ~/.aiphone/config.json （模式 0600）中，而不是您的注释中。 callme number 读回它，callme 对 <number> 更改它。

它是如何运作的

  • callme call 将您的问题发布到 Call Me 服务；您的 iPhone 会像真正的电话一样通过 CallKit 响起，TTS 说出问题，您的口头答复将被转录并返回给客服人员。 呼叫会一直阻塞，直到您接听为止——这就是重点。
  • callme text 发送推送通知消息；来自电话的回复被传送回启用通道的代理会话（Claude Code 插件）或通过 callme 监听/callme 事件获取。
  • 每个代理会话都会注册自己的号码和线程，因此您的手机会显示每个任务的单独的、有标题的对话。
